description: Connect your COROS account to explore private activity records, laps and FIT files; understand sleep, heart rate, HRV, stress, wellness checks, menstrual cycle data, fitness and recovery; and view your profile and devices. Create and update running, cycling and trail-running training plans and workouts, save reusable workout templates, and arrange workouts on your training schedule. Changes are saved to your COROS account only when requested. Health insights are informational, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
